entities.summary: King Sobhuza I (Somhlolo) was a monarchs & rulers in Eswatini (1780, Eswatini – 1836), a notable figure of the Early Modern era. Their work intersected with political systems and governance and empire and colonial dynamics. Established dynastic legacies and territorial boundaries.
